frog.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single reference image for image-to-3D modeling of a children's farm game toy. Create one adorable small green pond frog in a calm neutral sitting crouch, all four short chunky legs visible, broad rounded hind thighs and simple short webbed toes, rounded closed watertight-looking body, warm pale yellow-green belly, two friendly raised eyes with dark brown pupils and tiny highlights, subtle closed-mouth smile. The face looks diagonally toward the right of the image. High quality volumetric hand-sculpted painted toy, rounded natural anatomy matching warm farm animal figurines, smooth satin-matte finish, clean broad color areas, only a few subtle darker olive spots on the back. Three-quarter front view from slightly above, centered full body with generous white margins, isolated on pure white background with no floor shadow. Single frog only. No lily pad, base, water, plants, scenery, clothes, props, lettering, diagram, separate parts, open mouth, tongue, thin fingers or flat vector styling. The image must show a solid 3D figurine and clean readable silhouette appropriate for a compact 2500-triangle game model.
frog.review: Accepted: full body, neutral pose, closed mouth, broad limbs, no base/scenery. Four feet visible. Slight painted texture retained.

crow.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single reference image for image-to-3D of an articulated toy crow for a children's farm game. One friendly mischievous crow figurine, cute rounded charcoal-black body, big rounded head with warm dark eyes clearly readable against pale ivory small eye surrounds, sturdy charcoal beak, short tail, two short dark gray legs with sturdy toes. BOTH wings fully spread out sideways in a calm symmetrical airplane T-pose, each wing joins the body only through a small rounded shoulder, with white space between the wing trailing edge and the body. Wings are thick sculpted rounded paddles with 4 or 5 broad integrated feather lobes at their outer edges, no individual loose feathers. The complete chest, belly and sides beneath the wings are a smooth closed body, absolutely no second folded wings on the body. Show a front three-quarter view slightly from above, face angled a little toward viewer's right, with both entire outstretched wings and both legs visible and not cropped or occluded. Single high quality volumetric hand-sculpted painted farm animal toy, satin-matte charcoal and blue-gray subtly varied plumage, soft studio lighting, pure white background, centered with generous margins. Cute and rounded like collectible farm figurines; no aggressive eyebrows. No base, ground shadow, scenery, props, text, diagrams, multiple views, exploded parts, clothes, detached feathers, photorealism, thin paper wings, wireframe or flat vector style. Clear shoulder-to-body seams so the two wings can be separated for hinge rotation in a compact game mesh.
crow.review: Accepted: both wings extended, clear shoulder collars, no duplicate folded wings; solid rounded form. Final segmentation and closure must be verified on GLB.
